primary_systems.scope: GIFT v3.2 island checklist universe passing metadata-only eligibility

primary_estimand.name: cluster_weighted_C_minus_R3
primary_estimand.unit: prospectively frozen archipelago or regional block
primary_estimand.within_block: mean binary log-loss difference loss_C - loss_R3 across eligible island-by-species targets
primary_estimand.support_rule_per_system: point estimate < 0 and frozen block-bootstrap 95% upper limit < 0
primary_estimand.cross_taxon_claim: report mammal and plant system estimates side by side and pooled only under a predeclared taxon-adjusted hierarchical summary; neither taxon may rescue a failed other taxon primary

R0: predeclared biogeographic region or archipelago structure
C_add: training-only species-conditioned internal source continuity beyond R3 direct/diffuse source terms

leakage_firewall.rule: for every held-out block, all occupancy breadth, species_x_regional_pool, direct source, diffuse source and candidate continuity features are recomputed after removing the entire held-out block from the source pool

independence_gate.reason: the two mammal sources do not have a frozen common identifier namespace
independence_gate.required_final_gate: response-independent island identity crosswalk using frozen safe metadata/geography before any 5592 occurrence cell is opened
independence_gate.overlapping_islands_action: exclude from the 5592 test population before partition/model freezing
independence_gate.species_overlap: audit using response-blind species metadata where possible; shared species alone does not constitute shared response units

mammal_transport.allowed_semantic_open_before_independenc: first CSV field of header and 5592 data rows only

prohibited: use boreal as the macro-scale primary evidence
open 5592 mammal species headers or occurrence cells before the independence and preintake gates
request GIFT species composition before the GIFT metadata freeze is committed
compute source features using held-out-block occurrences
promote discovery-system results to confirmatory evidence
change the primary based on taxon-specific result direction
